label: PF Backlog 632
title: Worker fleet redesign (PARKED): state/coordination substrate + control plane + data plane per docs/WORKER-NEW-ARCHITECTURE.md
body:
Source: docs/WORKER-NEW-ARCHITECTURE.md (design note, status PARKED). EDP-17 (BI-PF-1309) is complete.

This item is the capture/registration step only. Gate 1 must still reconcile the note against the current assignment/lease/worktree/id/checkpoint code and produce: (a) an explicit keep/change/drop decision per current primitive, (b) an updated single-writer ownership table in the authoritative architecture surface, (c) child items with explicit dependencies (EDP-17, core/id_allocator.py, core/state_checkpoint.py, core/job_manager.py leases), and (d) owners/dates for the six open decisions in section 11. The note's current-state claims are inputs, not verified truth, until Gate 1.

brief.problem: Design note: docs/WORKER-NEW-ARCHITECTURE.md. Status PARKED (was: action after EDP-17; EDP-17/BI-PF-1309 is now completed, so Gate 1 review can start). Scope: redesign the PF worker workflow end-to-end - assignment, execution, coordination, state, delivery - with PF owning assignment + delivery and WorkerGrid remaining a thin runtime host (ADR-0003). This item covers Gate 1 reconciliation and the child-item breakdown; it does not approve implementation.

No implementation code is changed by this item: the diff is limited to the design note, its docs-index classification, backlog bookkeeping, and the id-block reservation for this item.
